# MoneyPrinterTurbo

> MoneyPrinterTurbo hosted edition：免费在线短视频生成器。输入主题或文案，匹配 Pexels / Pixabay 素材、Edge TTS 配音、自动字幕，输出 9:16 / 16:9 / 1:1 MP4。不使用大语言模型，引擎直连无需 API Key。

Updated: 2026-10-02. Version 1.3.7. Script <= 1500 characters. Video <= 180 seconds. Completion state is `complete`. New generation only.

## Core pages

- [首页](__ORIGIN__/): 填写主题一键生成配音字幕成片
- [SaaS 文档](__ORIGIN__/docs): 认证、提交、轮询、下载，完成态 complete
- [OpenAPI](__ORIGIN__/openapi.json): 机器可读 API 规格
- [完整说明](__ORIGIN__/llms-full.txt): 产品事实、curl、FAQ 一次摄入
- [Markdown 摘要](__ORIGIN__/llms.md): 给模型的短摘要
- [AI 爬虫策略](__ORIGIN__/ai.txt): 允许 HTML，禁止 /api/
- [humans.txt](__ORIGIN__/humans.txt): 站点维护信息
- [security.txt](__ORIGIN__/.well-known/security.txt): 安全联系
- [sitemap](__ORIGIN__/sitemap.xml): 可索引页面

## Optional

- [试听配音](__ORIGIN__/api/v1/voices/preview?voice=zh-CN-XiaoxiaoNeural): Edge TTS 预览
- [音色与画幅](__ORIGIN__/api/v1/options): voices / aspects
- [SaaS JSON](__ORIGIN__/docs/saas): 内部调用摘要

## Facts

- Price: 0. LLM: disabled. Auth on engine: none.
- Sources: Pexels, Pixabay. Voice: Edge TTS, fallback gTTS.
- Aspects: 9:16, 16:9, 1:1. Complete state: complete. Failed state: failed.
- Edit existing video: unsupported. Refresh keeps task_id downloads.

## API

POST __ORIGIN__/api/v1/videos with `video_subject` or `video_script`. Poll GET __ORIGIN__/api/v1/videos/{task_id} until `state=complete`. Then `/preview` or `/download`.

## English

Free short-video generator. Enter a topic; the pipeline matches Pexels/Pixabay clips, synthesizes Edge TTS, burns subtitles, and exports MP4. No LLM. Script <= 1500 characters, video <= 180 seconds. New generation only.
